The Expert List features members of ITRN who are available to deliver workshops, seminars, and training sessions on a wide range of topics related to Reproducibility and Open Science. Feel free to explore the list and to contact any ITRN members who may be able to help you.

If you would like your name to be included, please complete this [questionnaire](https://forms.gle/cU6bTPvMMpRhULTt7) and let us know by sending an email to [contact@itrn.org](mailto:contact@itrn.org).

[<i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i> Fill in the questionnaire](https://forms.gle/cU6bTPvMMpRhULTt7){.btn .btn-primary}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Please note that only ITRN members will be added to our Expert List.
:::
